scenario.name: r-cd-2-silent-wake
scenario.description: continue_delegate(mode='silent-wake') full path. Fires a delegate that returns silently and triggers a fresh parent turn without channel output.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}}: reply with DONE and the nonce only. Do not mutate files. Do not post to any channel.

liveRunSafety.notes: Live continuation row. Fail closed when token/session env is missing, serialize per target session, and treat generated output as a PASS-candidate until required receipts are reviewed.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the dispatching sessions.send request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate(mode=silent-wake)

expectedReceipts.name: task-ledger-entry
expectedReceipts.description: Optional extra context from the generic TaskFlow task ledger; continue_delegate does not reliably write here

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-key
expectedReceipts.description: Child session key from task metadata

expectedReceipts.name: parent-wake-event
expectedReceipts.description: Parent session wakes after silent return (session.message or run event with no channel delivery)

expectedReceipts.name: no-channel-delivery
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return does NOT produce a channel message (silent mode verified)

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID from dispatch response or optional task metadata; Tempo trace JSON must be fetched before folding a PASS.

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-lifecycle-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Redacted nonce-correlated typed continue_delegate tool span plus continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire on one silent-wake chain; generic delayed session traffic is non-authoritative context only.

review.notes: Silent-wake path. The WebSocket stream records behavioral context and no-channel delivery only. PASS-candidate requires the redacted nonce-correlated lifecycle receipt: typed continue_delegate tool execution plus continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire on one silent-wake chain. A nonce-correlated tasks.list row is optional because continue_delegate uses pending-delegate/subagent surfaces, not the generic task registry.
